subject: Interlock: MAP rebaseline request — Acme evaluation runway
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interlock: MAP rebaseline request — Acme evaluation runway

Sarah / Procurement team — quick update and ask. Procurement has signaled a likely 2–3 week slip on the PO due to internal legal review (we just got the heads-up this morning). That timing cascades into the evaluation plan in the MAP and will push the go/no-go gates out of the current calendar.

I propose the following so we can keep momentum without over-committing resources:
- Short-term: formally rebaseline the MAP dates with a 3-week extension to the evaluation runway (adjusted milestones in attached proposed_map_v2.xlsx).
- Mitigation: activate a phased evaluation so Acme can start smoke tests on a limited dataset using our hosted API while procurement closes (this reduces risk on their side and preserves time-to-value).
- Financial ask: we can offer a one-time service credit tied to delayed acceptance if we need to absorb infra costs during the extended period.

Please confirm: 1) procurement can target PO by Oct 6? 2) Are you comfortable approving the limited hosted phase while legal finishes the PO?

I attached a snapshot of the risk register (risk_log_snapshot.pdf) with impact/risk severity and a proposed decision cadence. If you prefer, we'll loop in sales leadership for an exec exception.

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: proposed_map_v2.xlsx (MAP v2), risk_log_snapshot.pdf (risk register excerpt)

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com, Tom Huang <tom.huang@acme.com>
Date: 2028-09-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interlock: MAP rebaseline request — Acme evaluation runway

Thanks Naomi — appreciate the heads up. Legal is deep in a template review this week; procurement expects formal approvals around Oct 3–6 but there is a non-zero chance of an extra week depending on signatory availability.

Tom and I discussed the hosted smoke test option and we're +1 on starting limited tests (read-only dataset, no PII) while procurement finishes. We would want the following spelled out before we begin:
- exact scope and data subsets allowed for smoke tests
- a written assurance around no-production-data ingestion
- a short SLA note for the limited phase

I will confirm PO ETA by EOD Friday (9/18).

– Sarah
Sarah Lee
Head of Data Platform, Acme Corp

On Sep 15, 2028, at 09:12, Naomi Feldman wrote:
> Sarah / Procurement team — quick update and ask. Procurement has signaled a likely 2–3 week slip...

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-18T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interlock: MAP rebaseline request — Acme evaluation runway

Sarah — thanks. Attached is an updated MAP and a short mitigation playbook: proposed_map_v2.xlsx includes the phased evaluation plan with clear gates, and the risk register page flags the three highest-impact items. High-level ask:
- Can procurement confirm the PO target of Oct 6 as our baseline? If yes, we'll mark the MAP with a 3-week extension and lock the smoke-test scope.
- From Redwood leadership: do we approve a one-time credit (up to 15% of first-month usage) to reduce friction of starting early while terms finalize? This would be conditional on the PO being signed within 30 days of acceptance.

If procurement can't meet Oct 6, we recommend a formal MAP rebaseline to Oct 20 and an executive review for credits. Please see the attached risk log snapshot for quantified impact.

Next steps we need from you: confirmation of PO ETA, sign-off for smoke test scope, and permission to table a credit request with my manager (Jonas).

Best — Naomi

Attachments: proposed_map_v2.xlsx, risk_log_snapshot.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: 2028-09-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interlock: MAP rebaseline request — Acme evaluation runway

Looping in exec perspective and a short decision matrix. Naomi — thanks for the proposed MAP. My take: approve the phased hosted smoke test (strictly scoped) today to preserve momentum. I will escalate the credit ask to sales leadership — I need two quick inputs:
- Maximum credit exposure (Naomi suggested 15%) — we need to cap liability and tie to PO receipt within X days.
- Fallback routing plan if hosted capacity becomes constrained during the smoke window (e.g., move to Dedicated pool or throttle test concurrency).

I attached a one-page decision_matrix.csv that maps outcomes to approvals. My recommended timeline:
1) 9/21: confirm smoke test scope and start data prep (redwood TOs)
2) 10/06: procurement target for PO; if not met -> formal rebaseline to 10/20
3) 10/20: final go/no-go gate; if procurement still not complete, escalate to revenue ops for decision.

On the credit: I'm comfortable authorizing up to a 10% service credit pending my manager's (VP Sales) sign-off. Anything >10% should go to finance. Laura — can you run the cost exposure estimate?

Jonas
VP, Sales Operations

Attachments: decision_matrix.csv

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: 2028-09-21T14:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interlock: MAP rebaseline request — Acme evaluation runway

Summary + ask for sign-off (short):
- Proposed rebaseline: move evaluation gate dates +3 weeks (MAP v2 attached).
- Risk posture: moderate — primary risk is legal/PO timing; mitigation is phased hosted evaluation with read-only data subset.
- Financial ask: approve up to 10% service credit cap conditioned on PO within 30 days. Cost exposure estimate attached.

Sign-off needed by COB 9/22 from: Jonas (approve credit up to 10%), Naomi (confirm smoke-test ops), Sarah/procurement (confirm PO ETA and signed scope).

Related links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ACME-2028-0842), DocuSign (https://docusign.com/ENVELOPE/0A9F2B).

Regards — Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Enterprise Sales

Attachments: cost_exposure_estimate.xlsx

From: Tom Huang <tom.huang@acme.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: 2028-10-02T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interlock: MAP rebaseline request — Acme evaluation runway

Naomi / Laura — sorry for the delay. Procurement confirms PO ETA of Oct 6 and legal expects to clear the template by Oct 5. We appreciate Redwood's flexibility.

We accept the phased hosted smoke test under the constraints you listed (read-only subset, no PII). We also accept the 10% credit cap conditional on PO issuance within 30 days.

I'll proceed with DocuSign when the PO template is ready — please send the final MAP v2 and decision matrix as a single package and I'll route for signatures.

Thanks — Tom
Tom Huang
Senior Manager, Procurement — Acme Corp

body_preview: Naomi requests a 3-week MAP rebaseline for Acme due to PO delay; proposes phased hosted smoke test and a capped 10% credit; procurement signals Oct 6 PO ETA; internal approval flow outlined.
